VII. Use of Production Data: Production conversations, prompts, user interactions, operational datasets or LLM responses shall not a utomatically be used for future model training or fine-tuning witho ut specific approval and appropriate sanitization. VIII. Secure Logging: Application/system logs shall, as far as pra cticable, avoid storing sensitive information such as complete user prompts, full documents/datasets, Aadhaar/PAN/banking details, pa sswords, authentication credentials/tokens, API keys or complete L LM responses containing personal, confidential or sensitive informa tion. IX. Encryption and Key Management: Appropriate encryption mechanisms shall be implemented, including TLS 1.2 or higher for data in transit, withTLS 1.3 preferred wherever feasible, encryption of sensitive datasets at rest, encrypted backups and secure crypto graphic key-management practices. X. Access Control: Access to LLM infrastructure, datasets, APIs, a dministrative interfaces, system logs and related resources shall b e governed through Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and the prin ciple of least privilege, supported by appropriate authentication, au thorization and audit mechanisms. **** .
